purpose: Astella bespoke silver/amethyst title wordmark and woodland title-screen comparison
scope: Preview only. New sibling logo and preview; existing title studies and live Unity assets remain unchanged.
inputImages: No edit target. Original bespoke title lettering generated from the existing Astella silver/amethyst/prism identity. The user's Shape of Dreams example informed the need for an illustrated title, not the letterforms.
inspection: Seven letters ASTELLA visually checked. PNG is Format32bppArgb. Grid sampling at an 8-pixel stride found 15919 fully transparent, 8823 translucent, and 10 opaque pixels; no background removal or bitmap rewriting was performed.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished, bespoke fantasy game title wordmark as a transparent-background PNG cutout for the original game ASTELLA.

EXACT WORD, clearly legible, single horizontal line: "ASTELLA". Seven Latin capital letters in this exact order A S T E L L A. No other words, no tagline, no Korean, no numbers. This is original title lettering artwork, not a normal font specimen. Keep the complete title visible.

Brand art direction: restrained silver and amethyst, stars, faceted prisms and magical crystal resonance, elegant and inviting. It must fit a luminous violet crystal woodland title screen. Custom engraved fantasy serif letterforms: tall confident capitals, sophisticated sharp wedge serifs, subtly tapered strokes, a few graceful sculptural flourishes. Main lettering is luminous ivory and polished pale silver with small lavender faceted bevels and a delicate dark indigo hairline keyline, so the word is extremely readable at a displayed width of 550 pixels over a dark blue forest. Make all letters substantial and readable, without thick cartoon outlines.

Integrate ornament INTO the wordmark silhouette rather than placing a detached generic badge above text. The left A has a refined elongated silver stroke and a tiny four-point star cut into its counter; the T rises slightly into a slender crystal-like finial. A fine asymmetrical silver resonance arc curves behind the letters from lower left toward upper right. At the LOWER CENTER just beneath the letters, one small faceted amethyst diamond prism sits in a restrained shallow V of silver filigree, echoing the game's existing prism HUD motif. A few small four-point starlight accents; do not fill the negative spaces. The word remains the main subject, crystal ornament is secondary. Unified elegant title-logo treatment, a clear memorable outline, tasteful detail, premium fantasy RPG identity, not a copy of any existing game logo.

Composition: wide compact horizontal logo, approximately 3:1 aspect silhouette, centered on the transparent canvas with only a small transparent safety margin. All flourishes and glow stay close to the letterforms. Genuine alpha background, no colored rectangle, no scene, no floor or shadow plane, no fake checkerboard, no clouds or smoke. No external frame, no shield, no crown, no big circle enclosing the whole word, no large jewel dwarfing text, no metallic gold, no orange, no heavy outer glow, no watermark, no extra labels. Original artwork, exactly one logo.
